lens.aspect: ANALYSIS.medium.marks and details: upper lashes as curved tapered liner strokes thick at the root; the lid fold as the hard upper contour; the warm fleshy peach and crimson of the left side
lens.place: A lid temple: a mirrored ridge of rose flesh terraces where the lashes stand as a curved colonnade, and the walk climbs the lid crease to the eye resting half-open under its fold.
lens.summary: A symmetric flesh-toned terrace temple lined with curved lash columns, a pointed lash arch at the crease, meibomian lamps, and the half-lidded eye enthroned at the head under a heavy rose lid.
lens.differs: Every earlier cosmos island sat in cold space; this one is all warm skin, built as architecture from the lid and lashes, with no nebula, asteroid or ring.
